decisions.reason: The firm has already publicized strong quantified customer savings for this modular concept and, given its fit with the announced strategic direction, management is very likely to continue rather than admit a mistaken investment.

This shredder is close to the core business and has been given its own product page across two years, so the public commitment and likely development effort make management inclined to persist despite limited visible performance evidence.
The product has visible customer reference evidence and quantified savings on the website, which reinforces both commercial promise and the tendency to stay committed to a prominently backed concept.

As a newly launched but core-adjacent shredder line presented on its own page, it carries fresh investment and public commitment that make withdrawal within a year unlikely unless results clearly fail.

Although newer and somewhat less proven than the others, it still builds on the established offer and has been publicly launched, so management would more likely continue and attribute any early weakness to temporary ramp-up factors.
